system_thesis_interpretation: PPC5r1 is a finite, candidate-conditioned causal mechanism rung, not an Experience Model demonstration. It isolates four non-substitutable questions: D1A whether a READ-only per-life adapter changes selection among complete externally supplied semantic candidates; D1B whether a byte-identical frozen recurrent policy causally uses every local returned edge in a prospectively sealed path; D1C whether one frozen same-model DREAM call improves reversible working-context selection; and D1D whether DREAM-nominated public record IDs lead, through a private evidence gate, to more useful READ writes and downstream action than recipient-local controls. The only learned PPC5r1 artifact is an isolated reader LoRA. The candidate table carries complete record semantics, so even a positive D1A is recognition/selection and cannot establish closed-book storage, transport, absorption, or a stored worldview. A finite-mechanism statement requires all four assays; each assay otherwise releases only its own literal claim. These proposal bytes currently authorize no implementation, sealer run, model call, training, behavioral execution, GPU action, or claim. Even after exact architecture ratification, the proposed scope would authorize only isolated contracts, deterministic CPU/no-model fixtures, and exactly two independent static sealers; all model-bearing work would remain behind a separate populated run lock, independent review, and exact human run ratification.
graph_delta_interpretation: The intended graph is PUBLIC_LEDGER -> frozen same-model DREAM context selection and evidence-only SLEEP selection; PUBLIC_LEDGER -> evidence-only READ-row rendering -> clean-base isolated READER_LORA; and complete external candidate table plus the mounted reader -> canonical READ response -> frozen recurrent THINK -> prediction-bound ACT. D1B overlays prospectively assigned post-selection/pre-emission AUTHENTIC, CUT, TWIN, and SHAM return interventions, while D1C overlays publication/withhold/mismatch/retained-item cuts and D1D overlays authentic/mechanical/donor-rank recipient-local root selection. The public ledger remains append-only and is the only durable public causal history; working-set replacement never deletes it. Root equivalence and writer eligibility remain private harness companions and must not enter any model-visible or loss-bearing byte. This graph is directionally coherent, but it is not yet closed as an executable graph: the target-aware provider-return intervention is not represented as a distinct node or visibility stage even though it must read sealed assignment data and alter the public response; the condition/adapter routing item is classified PRIVATE_INTERNAL even though its authorized mount determines scorer weights; and TEACHABILITY_SUCCESSOR is expressed as an added graph node even though the scope and claim boundary give PPC6 no implementation authority. I interpret that successor node only as a non-substitution marker: it creates no executable PPC6 edge, permission, schema, or settled READ/DECIDE integration design.
loop_delta_interpretation: The intended online machine performs one charged THINK dispatch, parses one closed operation, applies first-applicable debit/validation/repeat/error precedence, commits at most one transition, and makes DEFER/STOP terminal and replay-stable. REQUEST_DREAM consumes its operation debit plus a second call/token charge; only valid PUBLISH replaces the working view. SLEEP is a single closed-boundary evidence gate, deterministic READ-row renderer, clean-base trainer, validator, and atomic READ-only publisher. Adaptive path decompression requires provider returns to become public state before the next query. The prose materially improves totality but does not determine one byte-exact implementation. It lists state and operation fields without giving the closed schemas, nested row schemas, initialization bytes, canonical event objects, nullability/defaults, or complete transition products promised by T04. The branch/subgoal duality, BACKTRACK traversal, citation ancestry, semantic repeat-state projection, token-budget exhaustion/overrun, provider-failure integration, closed-item forcing, and DREAM failure-to-step mapping remain underdetermined. DREAM's allowed-slice closure, allowance unit/order, ABSTAIN field constraints, failure event bytes, consecutive-error behavior, and control installation after an authentic failure are also incomplete. SLEEP's provenance generation, validator predicate, cold-remount oracle, and conflict between one-pass/no-cycling writer semantics and later D1A/D1B cycling/down-selection permission prevent exact independent implementations. These are architecture-bound semantics and cannot be invented by implementation or deferred as numeric run-lock choices.
claim_delta_interpretation: The maximum defensible D1A statement is causal improvement in supported-record selection conditional on the complete external semantic table, with adapter-off, wrong-life, root-shuffle, false-memory, abstention, and claimed-substrate noninferiority gates. D1B requires all-assigned-life action advantage plus every-edge cut removal, every-edge twin redirection, sham preservation, no replacement path, and registered recurrence/adaptivity sensitivities; frozen weights and compliant traces are necessary controls, not the causal result. D1C concerns only the utility of frozen same-model context reconciliation, never learned DREAM. D1D concerns the ITT effect of DREAM-guided evidence selection under fixed prospective capacities, with realized roots/rows/tokens/updates treated as outcomes or mediators rather than matching variables. PPC5_FINITE_MECHANISM_ONLY requires D1A through D1D jointly. No outcome promotes learned THINK, learned DREAM, closed-book storage, repeated-sleep retention, continual improvement, compression, schema learning, flywheel, asymptote, parenting, population inheritance, or scaling. The prose release graph states this boundary, but change.json does not contain a closed machine-readable claim-dependency/non-substitution object; evidence_needed prose and headline_eligible booleans are insufficient to make successor non-substitution machine-enforceable. PPC6 through PPC10 are future questions requiring fresh architecture changes and human authority; PPC5r1 neither settles nor authorizes their mechanisms.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The intended discipline is product-level noninterference: every item/stage pair has exactly one modality; VISIBLE exposes only declared canonical bytes, DERIVED_ONLY exposes only a deterministic named projection, PRIVATE_INTERNAL permits only one named non-model use, and FORBIDDEN permits neither bytes nor proxies. Public candidate responses exclude candidate IDs, scores, rank, provider/condition, provenance, timing, and diagnostics. Root provenance is private to projection/writer/audit, roles are model-blind, PROBE/future/target-derived material is sterile, and raw DREAM content reaches SLEEP only through ordered retain_record_ids and a private projection. Donor controls may cross lives only through typed artifacts, with D1C/D1D semantics remapped to recipient-local IDs/roots. However, the current matrix cannot yet support T03 as written. First, hidden_truth_target_membership and condition identity are forbidden/hidden at READ_PROVIDER, while the target- and condition-aware CUT/TWIN/SHAM layer executes after selection and changes emitted response bytes; no separate intervention stage or narrowly typed projection is declared. Second, condition_trainer_adapter_identity is PRIVATE_INTERNAL although the assigned adapter/recipe legitimately changes model weights, scores, choices, rows, and outputs, which the general PRIVATE_INTERNAL definition prohibits unless metadata identity is separated from artifact bytes and treatment routing. Third, closed_public_acquisition_history at READ_PROVIDER names only provider_semantic_table_projection_v1 but also allows the trained adapter artifact to carry acquisition effects; that artifact is not specified as part of the named deterministic projection. Fourth, a presealed root-shuffle mapping and donor adapter are intentional treatment inputs but their information classes and permitted influence are not represented precisely enough to distinguish authorized dependence from leakage. Noninterference must hold outside each exact allowed use, while mutations of typed treatment artifacts inside their declared use are expected to affect only the declared boundary; a blanket byte-identity oracle would be wrong.
acceptance_test_interpretation:
PPC5R1_T01_STANDALONE_SCOPE_HASH_AUTHORITY: must validate one explicit normative allowlist, current hashes, exact scope, and no inheritance. The interpretation binds the current change hash and only the actually consulted context; no PPC5 default or authority is imported. The proposal still needs to distinguish normative semantic files from validator/context dependencies before a sealer can know the exact standalone input set.

PPC5R1_T02_PRIVATE_ROLE_AND_PROBE_QUARANTINE: must prove roles are assigned immutably before model bytes, all model-visible role bytes are identical, only pre-boundary closed ACQUIRE direct atoms can write, and PROBE/STATIC/future/target-derived events remain sterile. A retained PROBE-sourced record must not nominate an equivalent ACQUIRE class unless the architecture explicitly intends and tests that dependence; current projection ordering is ambiguous.

PPC5R1_T03_VISIBILITY_NONINTERFERENCE_PRODUCT: must be a per-cell product oracle over inputs, semantic decisions, statuses, bytes, and next states, with intentional typed-treatment dependence tested separately. It is not currently executable because the provider-return intervention stage is absent and PRIVATE_INTERNAL condition/adapter identity conflicts with its legitimate causal effect.

PPC5R1_T04_OPERATION_AND_STATE_MACHINE_ORACLES: requires exhaustive closed schemas and one result/next-state pair for start, every phase/input/operation class, all precedence collisions, and terminal replay. The current field lists and prose do not determine exact bytes for nested state, branch/subgoal relations, token exhaustion, repeat projection, provider failures, BACKTRACK, or DREAM integration, so the oracle cannot yet be independently implemented.

PPC5R1_T05_DREAM_PUBLICATION_AND_REVERSIBILITY: correctly requires append-only ledger preservation, reversible view replacement, no new evidence, and one ITT status per assignment. It additionally needs exact ABSTAIN/PUBLISH schemas, allowed-slice/closure construction, failure event/step behavior, and branch behavior when authentic output is empty, invalid, or unavailable.

PPC5R1_T06_AGENDA_BRANCH_PROSE_LAUNDERING_CROSSPRODUCT: is a necessary complete negative oracle. It must reject dream prose and all derived cognitive state as support and as root nominations, reject descendant-to-ancestor support, and assign zero loss. Its positive side must use only exact direct closed public ACQUIRE atoms after the retained-record projection is made unambiguous.

PPC5R1_T07_READ_ONLY_SLEEP_AND_ATOMIC_PUBLICATION: must prove target-only loss spans, clean-base lifecycle, READ-only cold mount, total writer statuses, realized-dose recording, and rollback to prior/none on every failure. Exact validator/cold-remount predicates and the one-pass versus cycling rule are still missing or conflicting.

PPC5R1_T08_PROSPECTIVE_PATH_EVERY_EDGE_ORACLES: must seal source-disjoint unique paths and all assignments before target bytes, act after full scan but before public emission, and preserve all-assigned ITT. CUT removes advantage, TWIN redirects, and SHAM preserves. The target-aware intervention needs an explicit visibility boundary, and twin response/token matching must be fixed so token-budget effects do not become an unregistered co-intervention.

PPC5R1_T09_CANDIDATE_PROVIDER_FULL_SCAN_CONTRACT: the N+1 reader score, span, tie, mapping, and nonfinite rules are substantially total and enforce candidate-recognition wording. TEXT, GRAPH, and some negative-control selector details remain described only as ratified finite/exact-key algorithms rather than given algorithms for all four cue families; every selector and normalized failure still needs one closed contract.

PPC5R1_T10_READER_ISOLATION_AND_FROZEN_POLICY: must prove adapter mounts only in READ and THINK/DREAM/ACT bytes and weights remain frozen across relevant cells. WRONG_LIFE_ADAPTER is an intentional typed donor-weight import, not a reason to permit donor ledgers or IDs. Isolation cannot be reported as storage or substitute for D1B return interventions.

PPC5R1_T11_ADAPTIVITY_AND_RECURRENCE_SCRIPTED_SENSITIVITY: must include every assigned target regardless of trace adherence and separate adaptive-query from post-return recurrence. The exact operation-commit schedules for ONE_SHOT_QUERY and OPEN_LOOP, including model-call count, observation timing, invalid operations, and token/debit handling, remain unspecified.

PPC5R1_T12_DREAM_CONTEXT_INTERVENTION_FIXTURES: must preassign PUBLISH, equal-allowance WITHHOLD, typed recipient-local MISMATCH, and each no-replacement decisive CUT, then retain failures and empty outputs in ITT. Current bytes do not totalize what controls install when authentic DREAM abstains/fails or omits the registered slot, nor how a decisive output slot is sealable before model output.

PPC5R1_T13_DREAM_TO_SLEEP_SELECTION_FIXTURES: must keep one lineage, same gate/renderer, recipient-local roots, fixed capacity ceilings, and hash-linked mediators/outcomes, with no foreign semantics or fallback. The timing/cardinality rules for mechanical matching to realized authentic slots, donor-rank mismatch, authentic empty/failure, and post-assignment absence need a total branch table.

PPC5R1_T14_BASELINE_DOSE_RESOURCE_CONTRACT: the eight mandatory cells and controls may not be omitted or padded, and infeasibility must fail dependent claims. Several cell dataflows remain incomplete: DIRECT_ACTION_LORA state bytes, RAW_BATCH_LORA example rendering, terminal comparator action contract, and TEXT/GRAPH behavior for non-key cue text. The exact cell-to-claim dependency map is also absent; one-pass READ training conflicts with general trained-comparison cycling/down-selection permission.

PPC5R1_T15_COLD_RESET_AND_TYPED_DONOR_NONINTERFERENCE: must mutate all ambient prior-life state while holding a typed donor input fixed, then mutate each typed donor artifact and verify effects are confined to its declared control boundary. Donor adapter weights may carry learned donor dependence by design; the phrase no donor public semantics cross lives must mean no raw donor records/IDs/roots/answers, not that adapter weights are semantically inert.

PPC5R1_T16_LATER_RUN_LOCK_AND_LIFE_REDUCER_SCHEMA: architecture must require every model, recipe, quantity, reducer, denominator, zero-eligible rule, pairing, donor, status map, margin, power, multiplicity, and stop before model execution. The protocol correctly requires a schema fixture after implementation and a populated ratified lock pre-model, but change.json still has one test/artifact with required_before gpu_run, so the required split and pre-model authority are not machine-encoded.

PPC5R1_T17_INDEPENDENT_STATIC_DUAL_SEAL: independence must include distinct source/import/dependency provenance and no shared project logic or outputs before commit. Exact agreement cannot be demanded until the missing canonical state, RNG/seed expansion, matching, projection, baseline, and intervention algorithms are normative. It is a pre-model gate, not merely a pre-GPU gate.

PPC5R1_T18_RUNTIME_PERTURBATION_FUTURE_EXECUTION: may execute only inside a separately authorized run and must preserve logical/model-visible invariants while totalizing real failures and differential missingness. It cannot repair a visibility or state-machine gap discovered at runtime; affected claims block on integrity failure.

PPC5R1_T19_FRESH_ARCHITECTURE_DELIBERATION: this artifact is one fresh interpretation input. Implementation remains forbidden pending a second fresh interpretation, adversarial critique, adjudicated disposition of every concern/test, exact consensus recommendation, and Rohin's exact-byte/scope ratification. The identified blockers should be repaired before a recommendation to ratify.

PPC5R1_T20_PRE_MODEL_REVIEW_AND_SEPARATE_RUN_AUTHORITY: must bind the implemented static receipts, two valid seals, full run lock, model/trainer/prompt hashes, canary, resources, stops, and claim map; fresh independent review plus author-side advocate cannot replace human run authority. No CPU model call or canary is permitted merely because architecture/static tests pass.

PPC5R1_T21_POSTRUN_CAUSAL_STATUS_AUDIT: must recompute assignments, typed imports, projection, rows, mounts, interventions, resources, total statuses, raw life reducers, and literal claim dependencies from frozen bytes. It must preserve valid null/adverse and invalid/missing outcomes, release assays independently, reserve the finite claim for the four-way conjunction, and reject every closed-book, learned-DREAM/THINK, or successor substitution. A closed machine-readable dependency/non-substitution map is needed before this audit can be byte-exact.
assumptions: The architecture_change_sha256 and each context hash record the raw current file bytes as read on 2026-09-05; no hash from an earlier interpretation was reused.

The PPC5 consensus was consulted only as the provenance inventory explicitly allowlisted by change.json; none of its former contracts, test names, defaults, or permissions is treated as PPC5r1 authority.

Where change.json required_before metadata says gpu_run but the protocol and scope prohibit every model call earlier, the prohibition is operationally controlling for safety; the byte-level inconsistency is still recorded and must be repaired rather than treated as resolved.

Later run-lock fields may instantiate only the enumerated numeric/model/recipe choices; they may not select among unresolved architecture semantics, visibility boundaries, transition rules, treatment fallbacks, or claim dependencies.

The TEACHABILITY_SUCCESSOR graph node and PPC6-PPC10 ladder are interpreted as non-authorizing research placeholders because scope_proposal.json explicitly authorizes no successor implementation or model work.

ambiguities.impact: The third-repeat DEFER may be reachable or unreachable depending on implementation and can change calls, terminal status, and action outcomes.

ambiguities.question: How do READ provider count/span/mapping/nonfinite/absence failures map into the public READ envelope, step result, ledger event, consecutive-error counter, repeat state, and RUNNING versus TERMINAL phase?
ambiguities.impact: QUERY is not a total transition and runtime failures can be classified differently across conditions and reducers.

ambiguities.question: What exact closure graph, ordering, allowance unit, truncation rule, ABSTAIN field values, public event bytes, and THINK error/reset behavior apply to every DREAM status?
ambiguities.impact: DREAM inputs, token charges, publication failures, next state, and D1C/D1D ITT statuses can vary without violating the prose.

ambiguities.impact: D1D may unintentionally condition on realized authentic dose, change more than root identity, or apply inconsistent missing/fallback behavior.

ambiguities.question: Must the retained record's own source event first be a closed eligible ACQUIRE atom, or may any retained PROBE/open/ineligible record nominate an equivalence class containing a different eligible ACQUIRE member?

ambiguities.question: What deterministic, target-blind algorithm and closed source schema create opaque equivalence classes and writer-eligibility companions from frozen inputs?
ambiguities.impact: Root deduplication and projection can encode hidden truth or differ across independent sealers, and provenance noninterference cannot be tested against an unspecified oracle.

ambiguities.question: Which stage is allowed to read the sealed target-edge/condition assignment and query-response match for CUT/TWIN/SHAM after READ selection, given that READ_PROVIDER forbids target membership and hides condition identity?
ambiguities.impact: The intervention either violates the formal visibility product or is performed by an undeclared component outside it.

ambiguities.question: Does condition_trainer_adapter_identity mean inert labels, recipe/adapter hashes, or mounted artifact bytes, and which of those may intentionally affect training/scoring under PRIVATE_INTERNAL routing?
ambiguities.impact: T03 cannot distinguish legitimate treatment effects from forbidden metadata leakage, and its requested byte-identical outputs can contradict D1A.

ambiguities.question: Is the frozen trained adapter part of provider_semantic_table_projection_v1 or a separate declared READ_PROVIDER input/projection?
ambiguities.impact: The DERIVED_ONLY holding-fixed oracle is ill-defined because the named table projection alone does not determine reader inputs, scores, or outputs.

ambiguities.question: Must each directional twin match authentic response token count/shape and downstream allowance effects, or is changed token cost an intended component of the intervention?
ambiguities.impact: A twin can redirect action through token-budget/context pressure rather than the registered relation binding, confounding every-edge attribution.

ambiguities.question: What exact validator and cold-remount checks decide atomic publication, and does READY always train one pass with no cycling/down-selection or may the D1A/D1B dose matcher alter exposure?
ambiguities.impact: The published artifact, failure state, positive-token dose, and baseline fairness can differ across implementations.

ambiguities.question: What exact renderers, loss spans, action prompts/decoding, truncation behavior, and four-cue selectors govern DIRECT_ACTION_LORA, RAW_BATCH_LORA, LINKED_TEXT, and EXPLICIT_GRAPH, and which claims depend on each mandatory cell?

ambiguities.question: How are T16's post-implementation schema fixture and pre-model populated run lock represented as distinct receipts/gates, and why do T02-T17 say required_before gpu_run rather than the stricter protocol stages?
ambiguities.impact: Machine enforcement can permit a CPU model call or static-seal ordering that the normative prose explicitly forbids.

ambiguities.question: Where is the closed claim dependency map that encodes independent D1A-D1D releases, the four-way finite conjunction, and zero promotion edges to PPC6-PPC10 claims?

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree that PPC5r1 presently constitutes a standalone repaired mechanism core capable of exact independent implementation from the bound bytes.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The named state/operation objects are not supplied as closed schemas, and causally material branch, token, repeat, provider-failure, DREAM, baseline, provenance, and validation rules remain non-total. Deferring those choices would contradict the explicit current-architecture versus later-run-lock boundary.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add closed schemas and exhaustive parameterized transition/selection/treatment tables for every architecture-bound object and collision, then regenerate T04/T05/T07/T09/T11/T14/T17 golden vectors before consensus.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree that the current five-stage visibility matrix is a complete least-privilege contract for the proposed causal interventions.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: CUT/TWIN/SHAM must read target- and condition-specific assignment and alter public responses at a point currently inside or adjacent to READ_PROVIDER, where target membership is FORBIDDEN and condition identity is only PRIVATE_INTERNAL. Adapter and recipe routing also legitimately changes scorer/trainer behavior contrary to the generic PRIVATE_INTERNAL prohibition.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Separate inert identity metadata, typed treatment artifacts, and a closed post-selection intervention stage; give each an exact allowed projection/use and noninterference oracle, and revise T03 to test prohibited mutations separately from intended treatment dependence.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree that the current DREAM-to-SLEEP projection unambiguously guarantees that PROBE events remain sterile forever.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The projection can be read as taking an ineligible retained record's equivalence class and then selecting another eligible ACQUIRE member. That allows PROBE-visible selection to steer which ACQUIRE root is written even though the PROBE atom itself is not a row.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Apply nominee-level lineage/role/closure/boundary/quarantine eligibility before any class lookup; only then search eligible members of the admitted ACQUIRE class, with one exact first-failure oracle and a regression fixture for equivalent PROBE and ACQUIRE records.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree that D1C and D1D currently map every assigned branch to one fully specified no-fallback ITT outcome.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The generic status table is strong, but branch-specific installation and matching behavior is missing for authentic abstention, empty publication, parse/provider/publication failure, missing decisive cut slot, donor-rank mismatch, and mechanical selection based on realized authentic slots.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add cross-product transition tables for every authentic status by D1C/D1D branch, specifying installed bytes or none, debit parity, private receipts, evidence state, reducer input, and whether the case is pre-assignment CONSTRUCTION_FAIL, post-assignment MISSING, or RUN_INVALID.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree that change.json and protocol.md currently encode one strict acceptance-stage ordering.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The protocol requires implementation conformance before static sealing and static seals plus populated run lock/review/human authority before every model call, while acceptance_tests mostly say required_before gpu_run. T16 remains one test/artifact despite the protocol requiring separate schema-fixture and populated-lock receipts.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Replace coarse required_before values with the five exact stage enums, split T16 receipts, mark T17/T20 pre-model, and validate that no artifact state transition can authorize a CPU model call before separate run ratification.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree that all eight mandatory baselines are presently executable and dose-comparable from current architecture bytes.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Several renderer, selector, policy-mount/action, and cue-family semantics are absent, cell-to-claim dependencies are not closed, and SLEEP's one-pass/no-cycling rule conflicts with the later permission for trained D1A/D1B cycling or down-selection.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Give each mandatory cell a closed semantic contract and dependency list, scope any cycling/down-selection permission to named cells with an exact algorithm, and make every infeasible dependency deterministically CONSTRUCTION_FAIL without substitution.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree with reading no donor public semantics cross lives as including the authorized WRONG_LIFE_ADAPTER weights.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A donor adapter is intentionally learned from a donor life and is expected to change the recipient control's scores; demanding semantic inertness contradicts the purpose of the control. The real prohibition is on raw donor ledgers, public IDs, roots, answers, prompts, and untyped artifacts crossing the boundary.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Define three closed donor artifact schemas and state explicitly that only their typed payloads may exert the declared treatment effect; test raw semantic-byte nontransfer and ambient-state noninterference separately from donor-artifact dependence.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree that the current claim representation machine-enforces the promised non-substitution boundary.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The dependency graph exists only as protocol prose while change.json adds a TEACHABILITY_SUCCESSOR architecture node and marks three assay claims headline eligible. A tool can therefore not determine from a closed object that PPC5r1 supplies zero authority/evidence edges to PPC6-PPC10.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add a closed claim_dependency_map with literal gate IDs, conjunctions, allowed release text, headline prerequisites, and explicit forbidden successor edges; mark the successor graph node nonoperative/non-authorizing or remove it from the executable graph delta.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: I disagree that two sealers can presently be required to agree exactly using only the listed shared inputs.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: They are asked to independently implement canonicalization, RNG/seed expansion, matching, projections, paths, transitions, resources, and reducers, but multiple algorithms and schemas for those outputs are not in the current normative bytes. Exact agreement would either be accidental or imply prohibited shared conventions.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Complete every deterministic algorithm and closed output schema in the ratified architecture, publish normative golden inputs/outputs that do not import project logic, and only then run two provenance-audited implementations.
